title: Zoning text change for Park Avenue rezoning, Bedford-Stuyvesant
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for the Park Avenue rezoning in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would enable ten new buildings of five to 11 stories totaling 394,000 square feet of residential space with 391 units, 101 of them income-restricted, plus commercial and school space for over 2,500 students. The Council approved the measure on October 8, 2026.
